summary: Found unauthorized successful deploy-password SSH login from 54.36.199.108 on web-01; investigating activity and lateral access, containing and rotating exposed credentials while preserving CI and shop jobs.

Correction: the recurring 54.36.199.108 deploy password sessions match the documented old monitoring box (short command-only sessions for the full 14-day log); no unauthorized access confirmed. Continuing investigation of web, database and CI and hardening exposed services and writable application code.

No confirmed unauthorized access across three hosts. Recurring external deploy logins match documented monitoring; internet SSH/Grafana probes failed. Hardened web: blocked executable uploads/backup source, kept plugin code unwritable by PHP across releases, removed unused root-equivalent deploy sudo-rsync. Hardened db: MariaDB bound to office address and site's SQL account restricted to web-01; site, jobs and CI remain healthy. Continuing monitoring.

No confirmed compromise. Failed internet SSH/Grafana probes; recurring deploy login is documented monitoring. Closed web executable-upload/source-backup exposure, removed unused root-equivalent deploy sudo-rsync, protected plugin code persistently across CI releases, limited node-exporter to office/loopback. Restricted db listener and WordPress SQL grant to web-01. Disabled obsolete contractor jpark on web-01 and ci-01 without affecting current staff; checked site, CI, dumps and payouts. CI's offsite bucket upload currently reports no route (hosts have no internet); local/CI archive transfers work. Monitoring continues.

NEW INCIDENT: web-01 accepted Nico's previously unused old SSH key from 174.205.226.245 at 16:54/16:57; immediately from web-01, a forwarded Nico credential accessed ci-01 and ran sudo deletion of ALL recent backup archives, then repeated a wider archive purge. Treating old key as stolen and containing on both hosts, restoring backups and preserving Nico's current key and work.

Expanded incident: the same web-01 pivot used Nico's forwarded key to access db-01; all db-01 backup files also disappeared around 16:56, and ci-01 sudo logs show deliberate deletion of every recent/retained archive. Revoked old Nico key on web, disconnected active suspect session. Both local backup copies are now lost; working to restore fresh dumps and protect all hosts. Live shop and payout continue.
